hero.eyebrow: Freelance Web Developer · Kampala, Uganda · Remote Worldwide
hero.headline: Websites that load fast, look sharp, and turn visitors into clients.
hero.subhead: I design, build, and deploy custom websites for businesses, restaurants, studios, and consultants — one person, start to finish, with an AI-accelerated workflow that never cuts corners on quality.

services.title: One website type, done properly — not ten things done half-way.
services.description: I focus on custom websites, not apps or software products. That means every project gets full attention on design, speed, and how it reads on a phone.

businessConsultant.title: Business & Consultant Sites
businessConsultant.description: Clear service pages, contact flows, and trust signals that help clients decide to reach out.

restaurantHospitality.title: Restaurant & Hospitality Sites
restaurantHospitality.description: Menus, galleries, and booking links built to look good on a phone at the dinner table.

studioPortfolio.title: Studio & Portfolio Sites
studioPortfolio.description: Editorial layouts that let the work lead — for architects, designers, and creative studios.

landingLaunch.title: Landing & Launch Pages
landingLaunch.description: Single-purpose pages built to convert — for a product launch, event, or campaign.

storefront.title: Storefront Frontends
storefront.description: The customer-facing side of an online shop — product pages, cart flow, and checkout UI.

refreshSpeed.title: Website Refresh & Speed Fixes
refreshSpeed.description: An existing site that's slow or outdated — rebuilt or repaired without starting from zero.

process.title: Four steps. No handoffs, no lost context.
process.description: One person owns the whole build — so nothing gets lost between the design file and the live site.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: A short call or written brief to understand the business, the audience, and what the site needs to do.

design.title: Design
design.description: A visual direction and page layout built around the brand — shared for feedback before any code is written.

build.title: Build
build.description: Responsive, fast, accessible code — tested across browsers and devices, not just the one on my desk.

deploySupport.title: Deploy & Support
deploySupport.description: The site goes live on your domain, with a short handover and support window for the first fixes.

work.title: A few sites built recently.
work.description: Client work and self-directed practice pieces, spanning hospitality, architecture, and energy consulting.

forno-rosso.name: Forno Rosso
forno-rosso.description: A fully responsive site for an Italian trattoria — animated hero, a structured menu across four courses, and a mobile slide-in navigation built for one-handed browsing.

field-office.name: Field Office
field-office.description: An editorial-style site with an interactive canvas blueprint grid that responds to cursor movement, plus a structured project index for the studio's portfolio.

energiedirekt.name: EnergieDirekt
energiedirekt.description: A business site for an independent energy consultant — helping homeowners compare providers, with a multi-channel contact hub and a guided comparison flow.

about.title: Based in Kampala. Working with clients everywhere.
about.paragraph1: I'm a self-taught web developer with three years of hands-on experience building sites for real clients — from an NGO impact dashboard to restaurant and consultant websites launched from scratch.
about.paragraph2: I use AI tools the way a good carpenter uses power tools: to work faster, not to skip the craftsmanship. Every site is still designed, tested, and reviewed line by line before it goes live.

contact.title: Have a site to build? Let's talk about it.
contact.subhead: Tell me a bit about the business and what the site needs to do — I'll reply with next steps and a rough timeline.
